title: Incident: detection, communication and blameless postmortem

videos.script: Every lesson so far has been preparation. This one is Thursday afternoon. {{thursday}} At 14:05 checkouts start failing. Ten minutes later somebody's phone rings. What happens next is not a technology problem. Who leads, who talks to customers, who changes what. {{people}} Afterwards comes the part that makes the next Thursday less likely: a postmortem that asks what, not who. {{postmortem}} You will measure the incident, rebuild its timeline from three sources, and find the change that started it. {{end}}
